method: Primary executor compares actual current source quotations, learned frame relations, slot bindings and actual used-record indices; native answers are reported separately and never used to rewrite outputs. This is recorded source-semantic review, not a formal verifier or new gold annotation.

source_fit_decision: Keep the original five datasets. Current TRAIN contains real recipient-owner, action-scope, nested qualification and anaphoric-link distinctions. The acquisition/runtime object fails to preserve them reliably. This is not evidence that native data must be replaced.
next_research_object: Source-neutral relational compiler skills with explicit actor-relative recipient ownership, action/qualification binding and separately learned clause links. Training examples remain evidence at acquisition, not current-source values at runtime. A signature-only removal-of-examples baseline is required to test whether a trivial prompt cleanup explains any gain. Independent free acquisition remains necessary.
